Remark
[failure in odd dimensions]

Source: petersen:page-0335 ↗ thm:pet-ch8-berger-killing-field-zero section 3 fails in odd dimensions: the unit vector field generating the Hopf fibration $S^3(1)\to S^2(1/2)$ is a Killing field on the positively curved, odd-dimensional manifold $S^3(1)$ that is nowhere zero.
